questions.question: When King Sennacherib of Assyria captured Judah's fortified cities, what did King Hezekiah offer to do?

answers.text: Send troops to fight Assyria's wars

questions.question: After King Hezekiah paid Assyria's king a large amount of silver and gold, the Assyrian king left Jerusalem alone. True or false?
